page.layout: One column of text under a centred heading "LECTORI."; no margin notes; catchword "Omnes" at the lower right.

main_text.head: LECTORI.
main_text.p: fragalitati commodos ferre potuisset ; ast præmaturâ morte extinctus , ac ex inquietudinum hac valle à Deo Optimo Maximo ad Cælestia sublatus :
Verum illud Horatii Carminum Lib. ij. Ode. xvj.
nec insubidè idem Canit, Ode. tertiâ Carminum Lib. ij.

page.notes: The line "fragalitati commodos ferre potuisset" is printed as "fragilitati" in the scan's word-division; transcribed as printed in the scan where legible. Some words in the Horace quotation are read with [?] doubt: none marked. The first line's text is visible only partly at the left edge. The dashes before "omnes una manet nox" stand for omitted words in the original.
